# Setup

## Load Libraries & Configuration

```{r load-packages}
source(here::here("_load_all.R"))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(lme4)
  library(emmeans)
  library(variancePartition)
  library(cowplot)
  library(ggnewscale)
  library(ggpattern)
  library(ARTool)
})

cat("✓ All packages loaded\n")
cat("  Project root:", here::here(), "\n")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Data Loading & Preparation

## Load Raw Data

```{r load-data}
SALA_highdose       <- readr::read_csv(here::here(PATH_DATA_RAW, "SALA_MSD.csv"))
metadata_SALA1_1152 <- readr::read_csv(here::here(PATH_DATA_RAW, "2025_SALA1_1152_metadata.csv"))

cat("✓ Raw data loaded\n")
cat("  MSD rows:", nrow(SALA_highdose),
    "| Metadata rows:", nrow(metadata_SALA1_1152), "\n")
```

## Build SALA_full

```{r build-sala-full}
SALA_avg  <- average_nonzero_by_sample(SALA_highdose)
SALA_full <- build_sala_full(SALA_avg, metadata_SALA1_1152) %>%
  dplyr::filter(EXPOSURE != "Untreated_Control")

# normalize column types and make exposure values consistent for all later joins
SALA_full <- SALA_full %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~ trimws(.x)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of(c("SAMPLEID", "CELLTYPE", "EXPOSURE", "HORMONE", "PATIENTCODE", "SEX", "SMOKER")), as.character)
  )

cytokine_cols_all <- intersect(names(SALA_full), cytokine_llod$Analyte)
SALA_full <- SALA_full %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cytokine_cols_all), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))

available_high_dose_exposures <- intersect(
  ALL_HIGH_DOSE_EXPOSURES,
  sort(unique(as.character(SALA_full$EXPOSURE)))
)

cat("✓ SALA_full built\n")
cat("  Rows    :", nrow(SALA_full), "\n")
cat("  CELLTYPE:", paste(levels(SALA_full$CELLTYPE), collapse = " | "), "\n")
cat("  HORMONE :", paste(levels(SALA_full$HORMONE),  collapse = " | "), "\n")
cat("  TIMEPOINT:", paste(levels(SALA_full$TIMEPOINT), collapse = " | "), "\n")
cat("  SEX     :", paste(levels(SALA_full$SEX),      collapse = " | "), "\n")
cat("  EXPOSURE:", paste(sort(unique(as.character(SALA_full$EXPOSURE))), collapse = " | "), "\n")
cat("✓ Available high-dose exposures in this dataset:\n")
print(available_high_dose_exposures)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Cytokine & Imputation Setup

Imputes values below LLOD (LOD/√2) using a single global pass over `SALA_full`.
The **sole cytokine-inclusion gate** is `impute_lod_sqrt2()`'s `ZERO_CUTOFF` (≤ 30% NA/zero
per SEX group). The old dotplot-specific > 50% imputed filter is dropped: cytokine
validity is now determined consistently by the LMER pipeline (`valid_cytokines` inside
`run_lmer_chunk()`), which applies the identical `ZERO_CUTOFF`. The global `imp`/`df_use`
objects are used only for visualization (log₂FC, bar heights, raw-data points).

```{r cytokine-setup}
cytokine_cols_all <- intersect(names(SALA_full), cytokine_llod$Analyte)
imp    <- impute_lod_sqrt2(
  input_data    = SALA_full,
  cols          = cytokine_cols_all,
  cytokine_llod = cytokine_llod,
  zero_cutoff   = ZERO_CUTOFF
)
df_use <- imp$data

cat("✓ Global imputation complete\n")
cat("  Valid cytokines:", length(imp$valid_cytokines), "\n")
cat("  Skipped (>", ZERO_CUTOFF * 100, "% zeros):",
    nrow(imp$skipped_cytokines), "\n\n")
```

## Combine LMER plot data

```{r lmer-combine}
lmer_results_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  LAE_NONE_res$lmer_plot_data,
  LAE_E2_res$lmer_plot_data,
  SAE_NONE_res$lmer_plot_data,
  SAE_E2_res$lmer_plot_data
)

required_cols <- c(
  "SEX","CELLTYPE","HORMONE","EXPOSURE","CYTOKINE",
  "estimate","SE","p.value","q","sig"
)
for (nm in required_cols) {
  if (!nm %in% names(lmer_results_all)) lmer_results_all[[nm]] <- NA
}

lmer_results_all <- lmer_results_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    SEX      = as.character(SEX),
    CELLTYPE = as.character(CELLTYPE),
    HORMONE  = as.character(HORMONE),
    EXPOSURE = as.character(EXPOSURE),
    CYTOKINE = as.character(CYTOKINE),
    estimate = as.numeric(estimate),
    SE       = as.numeric(SE),
    p.value  = as.numeric(p.value),
    q        = as.numeric(q),
    sig      = as.logical(sig)
  )

cat("✓ lmer_results_all:", nrow(lmer_results_all), "rows\n")
cat("  Significant (q <", ALPHA_Q, "):", sum(lmer_results_all$sig %in% TRUE), "\n")

SALA_TMR_sig <- SALA_full %>%
  dplyr::filter(HORMONE == "NONE") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SAMPLEID, CELLTYPE, PATIENTCODE, TIMEPOINT, SEX, EXPOSURE, HORMONE,
    dplyr::any_of("SMOKER"),
    dplyr::any_of(cytokine_cols_all)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::any_of(cytokine_cols_all),
    names_to  = "CYTOKINE",
    values_to = "VALUE"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    lmer_results_all %>%
      dplyr::filter(HORMONE == "NONE") %>%
      dplyr::select(SEX, CELLTYPE, HORMONE, EXPOSURE, CYTOKINE, q, sig),
    by = c("SEX", "CELLTYPE", "HORMONE", "EXPOSURE", "CYTOKINE")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sig = ifelse(is.na(sig), FALSE, sig))

save_table(SALA_TMR_sig, "SALA_no_ESTRADIOL_with_sig.csv")
cat("✓ SALA_no_ESTRADIOL_with_sig.csv saved (includes sig/q columns)\n")
```

# Cytokine Dotplots

```{r cytokine-dotplot, fig.width=14, fig.height=8, results='asis'}
UP_COLOR       <- "#D7191C"
DOWN_COLOR     <- "#2C7BB6"
ESTRADIOL_FILL <- "#E8F5E9"

for (target_exposure in available_high_dose_exposures) {

  cat("\n\n## Exposure:", target_exposure, "\n\n")

  exp_short       <- sub(" \\S+$", "", target_exposure)
  e2_label        <- paste(exp_short, "+ E2")
  hormone_levels  <- c(exp_short, e2_label)
  safe_exp        <- safe_name(target_exposure)
  border_color    <- EXPOSURE_COLORS_DEEP[[target_exposure]]
  panel_fill_none <- EXPOSURE_COLORS_LIGHT[[target_exposure]]

  if (is.null(border_color) || is.null(panel_fill_none)) {
    warning(sprintf("No color mapping found for exposure '%s'; skipping plots.", target_exposure))
    next
  }

  lmer_exp <- lmer_results_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(EXPOSURE == target_exposure)

  cat("  Cytokines tested by LMER:", length(unique(lmer_exp$CYTOKINE)), "\n")
  cat("  (Cytokines excluded by ZERO_CUTOFF are reported inside run_lmer_chunk)\n")

  lmer_exp_F   <- lmer_exp %>% dplyr::filter(SEX == "F") %>% recode_hormone_labels(exp_short, e2_label, hormone_levels)
  lmer_exp_M   <- lmer_exp %>% dplyr::filter(SEX == "M") %>% recode_hormone_labels(exp_short, e2_label, hormone_levels)
  lmer_exp_All <- lmer_exp %>% dplyr::filter(SEX == "All") %>% recode_hormone_labels(exp_short, e2_label, hormone_levels)

  keep_cytokines <- dplyr::bind_rows(lmer_exp_F, lmer_exp_M, lmer_exp_All) %>%
    dplyr::filter(sig) %>%
    dplyr::pull(CYTOKINE) %>%
    unique()

  cat("  Significant cytokines (q <", ALPHA_Q, "):", length(keep_cytokines), "\n")

  if (length(keep_cytokines) == 0) {
    cat("  → No significant cytokines; skipping plots.\n")
    next
  }

  long_target <- make_log2fc_long(df_use, keep_cytokines) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      EXPOSURE == target_exposure,
      as.character(SEX) %in% c("F", "M")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      SEX       = factor(as.character(SEX), levels = SEX_LEVELS),
      TIMEPOINT = factor(as.character(TIMEPOINT), levels = TIMEPOINT_LEVELS)
    ) %>%
    recode_hormone_labels(exp_short, e2_label, hormone_levels)

  if (nrow(long_target) == 0) {
    cat("  No log2FC rows for this exposure.\n")
    next
  }

  cyt_order <- long_target %>%
    dplyr::group_by(CYTOKINE) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(score = mean(abs(log2FC), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(score)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(CYTOKINE)

  sig_map_sex <- dplyr::bind_rows(lmer_exp_F, lmer_exp_M) %>%
    dplyr::filter(CYTOKINE %in% keep_cytokines) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      SEX      = factor(as.character(SEX),     levels = SEX_LEVELS),
      CELLTYPE = as.character(CELLTYPE),
      HORMONE  = factor(as.character(HORMONE), levels = hormone_levels),
      CYTOKINE = as.character(CYTOKINE),
      q        = as.numeric(q)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(SEX, CELLTYPE, HORMONE, CYTOKINE) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      q   = min(q, na.rm = TRUE),
      sig = q < ALPHA_Q,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::expand_grid(TIMEPOINT = factor(TIMEPOINT_LEVELS, levels = TIMEPOINT_LEVELS))

  sig_map_all <- lmer_exp_All %>%
    dplyr::filter(CYTOKINE %in% keep_cytokines) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      CELLTYPE = as.character(CELLTYPE),
      HORMONE  = factor(as.character(HORMONE), levels = hormone_levels),
      CYTOKINE = as.character(CYTOKINE),
      q        = as.numeric(q)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(CELLTYPE, HORMONE, CYTOKINE) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      q          = min(q, na.rm = TRUE),
      sig_pooled = q < ALPHA_Q,
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::expand_grid(TIMEPOINT = factor(TIMEPOINT_LEVELS, levels = TIMEPOINT_LEVELS))

  make_plot_df <- function(df, grp_vars, sig_join, sig_col) {
    df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(grp_vars))) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(mean_log2FC = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(CYTOKINE = factor(as.character(CYTOKINE), levels = cyt_order)) %>%
      add_rescaled_size("mean_log2FC", transform = "sqrt", out_col = "size_val") %>%
      dplyr::left_join(sig_join, by = grp_vars) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        q          = ifelse(is.na(q), 1, q),
        !!sig_col  := ifelse(is.na(.data[[sig_col]]), FALSE, .data[[sig_col]]),
        panel_fill = ifelse(as.character(HORMONE) == e2_label, ESTRADIOL_FILL, panel_fill_none),
        direction  = dplyr::case_when(
          mean_log2FC > 0 ~ "Up",
          mean_log2FC < 0 ~ "Down",
          TRUE            ~ "Zero"
        )
      )
  }

  plot_df_pooled <- make_plot_df(long_target, c("CELLTYPE", "HORMONE", "TIMEPOINT", "CYTOKINE"), sig_map_all, "sig_pooled") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(All = factor("All", levels = "All"))

  plot_df_sex <- make_plot_df(long_target %>% dplyr::mutate(SEX = factor(as.character(SEX), levels = SEX_LEVELS)), c("SEX", "CELLTYPE", "HORMONE", "TIMEPOINT", "CYTOKINE"), sig_map_sex, "sig") %>%
    dplyr::filter(as.character(SEX) %in% c("F", "M")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(SEX = factor(as.character(SEX), levels = SEX_LEVELS))

  cyt_levels <- levels(factor(plot_df_pooled$CYTOKINE, levels = cyt_order))

  plot_df_pooled_sig <- plot_df_pooled %>% dplyr::filter(sig_pooled)
  plot_df_sex_sig <- plot_df_sex %>% dplyr::filter(sig)

  if (nrow(plot_df_pooled_sig) == 0 && nrow(plot_df_sex_sig) == 0) {
    cat("  No plotted rows after significance filtering; skipping figures.\n")
    next
  }

  p_pooled <- make_dotplot(plot_df_pooled_sig, "All", paste(target_exposure, "— Pooled (All Samples)"), cyt_levels, border_color, UP_COLOR, DOWN_COLOR, show_y = TRUE)
  p_sex <- make_dotplot(plot_df_sex_sig, "SEX", paste(target_exposure, "— By Sex"), cyt_levels, border_color, UP_COLOR, DOWN_COLOR, show_y = FALSE)

  legend_shared  <- cowplot::get_legend(p_pooled)
  p_pooled_noleg <- p_pooled + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
  p_sex_noleg    <- p_sex    + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")

  p_combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    p_pooled_noleg, p_sex_noleg, legend_shared,
    nrow       = 1,
    rel_widths = c(1.2, 1.2, 0.4),
    align      = "h",
    axis       = "tb"
  )

  print(p_combined)

  out_prefix <- paste0("dotplot_", safe_exp)
  save_plot(paste0(out_prefix, "_combined.png"), p_combined, width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  save_plot(paste0(out_prefix, "_combined_transparent.png"), p_combined, width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "transparent")
  save_plot(paste0(out_prefix, "_pooled.png"), p_pooled, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  save_plot(paste0(out_prefix, "_sex.png"), p_sex, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  for (cyt in keep_cytokines) {
    donor_plate <- imp$data %>%
      dplyr::filter(EXPOSURE == target_exposure, SEX %in% c("F", "M")) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(PATIENTCODE)

    d_raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      imp$data %>%
        dplyr::filter(SEX %in% c("F", "M"), EXPOSURE == target_exposure) %>%
        dplyr::semi_join(donor_plate, by = "PATIENTCODE"),
      imp$data %>%
        dplyr::filter(SEX %in% c("F", "M"), EXPOSURE == PBS_LEVEL) %>%
        dplyr::semi_join(donor_plate, by = "PATIENTCODE")
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        HORMONE  = dplyr::recode(as.character(HORMONE), "NONE" = exp_short, "Estradiol" = e2_label),
        HORMONE  = factor(HORMONE, levels = hormone_levels),
        TIMEPOINT = factor(as.character(TIMEPOINT), levels = TIMEPOINT_LEVELS),
        SEX      = factor(as.character(SEX), levels = SEX_LEVELS),
        VALUE    = .data[[cyt]],
        EXPOSURE = factor(EXPOSURE, levels = c(PBS_LEVEL, target_exposure))
      )

    sig_for_cyt <- sig_map_sex %>%
      dplyr::filter(CYTOKINE == cyt) %>%
      dplyr::select(CELLTYPE, HORMONE, TIMEPOINT, SEX, q, sig)

    male_pt_fill <- grDevices::adjustcolor(border_color, alpha.f = 1,
                                           red.f = 1.3, green.f = 1.3, blue.f = 1.3)

    summary_raw <- d_raw %>%
      dplyr::group_by(SEX, EXPOSURE, HORMONE, CELLTYPE, TIMEPOINT) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        mu = mean(VALUE, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = sd(VALUE,   na.rm = TRUE),
        n  = dplyr::n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        panel_fill = ifelse(as.character(HORMONE) == e2_label, ESTRADIOL_FILL, panel_fill_none),
        bar_fill   = border_color,
        bar_color  = border_color,
        direction  = dplyr::case_when(
          mu > 0 ~ "Up",
          mu < 0 ~ "Down",
          TRUE   ~ "Zero"
        ),
        sig_color  = dplyr::case_when(
          direction == "Up"   ~ UP_COLOR,
          direction == "Down" ~ DOWN_COLOR,
          TRUE                ~ "grey50"
        ),
        x_label = factor(
          dplyr::case_when(
            SEX == "M" & EXPOSURE == PBS_LEVEL       ~ "M Control",
            SEX == "M" & EXPOSURE == target_exposure ~ paste("M", exp_short),
            SEX == "F" & EXPOSURE == PBS_LEVEL       ~ "F Control",
            SEX == "F" & EXPOSURE == target_exposure ~ paste("F", exp_short)
          ),
          levels = c("M Control", paste("M", exp_short), "F Control", paste("F", exp_short))
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(sig_for_cyt, by = c("CELLTYPE", "HORMONE", "TIMEPOINT", "SEX")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        q         = as.numeric(q),
        sig       = ifelse(is.na(sig), FALSE, sig),
        sig_label = dplyr::case_when(
          is.na(q)  ~ "",
          q < 0.001 ~ "***",
          q < 0.01  ~ "**",
          q < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE      ~ ""
        )
      )

    d_raw <- d_raw %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        x_label = factor(
          dplyr::case_when(
            SEX == "M" & EXPOSURE == PBS_LEVEL       ~ "M Control",
            SEX == "M" & EXPOSURE == target_exposure ~ paste("M", exp_short),
            SEX == "F" & EXPOSURE == PBS_LEVEL       ~ "F Control",
            SEX == "F" & EXPOSURE == target_exposure ~ paste("F", exp_short)
          ),
          levels = c("M Control", paste("M", exp_short), "F Control", paste("F", exp_short))
        ),
        point_fill  = dplyr::case_when(
          SEX == "M" & EXPOSURE == PBS_LEVEL       ~ "grey80",
          SEX == "M" & EXPOSURE == target_exposure ~ male_pt_fill,
          TRUE                                     ~ "white"
        ),
        point_color = dplyr::case_when(
          EXPOSURE == PBS_LEVEL       ~ "grey40",
          EXPOSURE == target_exposure ~ border_color,
          TRUE                        ~ "grey40"
        )
      )

    p_hist <- make_cytokine_histogram(d_raw, cyt, target_exposure)
    p_bar <- make_cytokine_barplot(
      summary_raw     = summary_raw,
      d_raw           = d_raw,
      cyt             = cyt,
      target_exposure = target_exposure,
      exp_short       = exp_short,
      e2_label        = e2_label,
      hormone_levels  = hormone_levels,
      border_color    = border_color,
      panel_fill_none = panel_fill_none,
      alpha_q         = ALPHA_Q,
      trend_alpha     = TREND_ALPHA,
      up_color        = UP_COLOR,
      down_color      = DOWN_COLOR,
      estradiol_fill  = ESTRADIOL_FILL
    )

    cyt_safe <- safe_name(cyt)
    cyt_subdir <- paste0("cytokine_plots_", safe_exp)
    ensure_dir(here::here(PATH_OUTPUT_FIGS, cyt_subdir))

    save_plot(file.path(cyt_subdir, paste0("histogram_", cyt_safe, ".png")), p_hist, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
    save_plot(file.path(cyt_subdir, paste0("barplot_", cyt_safe, ".png")), p_bar, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
  }

  cat("✓ Done:", target_exposure, "\n\n")
}
```

# Variance Analysis

```{r smoker-variance, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
stopifnot("SMOKER" %in% names(SALA_full))

vp_results_list <- list()
vp_summary_list <- list()

for (exp in available_high_dose_exposures) {
  cat("\n── Variance partition:", exp, "──\n")

  df_exp <- imp$data %>%
    dplyr::filter(SEX %in% c("F", "M"), EXPOSURE %in% c(PBS_LEVEL, exp)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      SMOKER      = factor(SMOKER),
      SEX         = factor(SEX, levels = SEX_LEVELS),
      HORMONE     = factor(HORMONE, levels = HORMONE_LEVELS),
      TIMEPOINT   = factor(TIMEPOINT, levels = TIMEPOINT_LEVELS),
      CELLTYPE    = factor(CELLTYPE, levels = CELLTYPE_LEVELS),
      PATIENTCODE = factor(PATIENTCODE),
      EXPOSURE    = factor(EXPOSURE)
    )

  if (!"SMOKER" %in% names(df_exp) || length(unique(df_exp$SMOKER)) < 2) {
    cat("  ⚠ SMOKER not available or has < 2 levels; skipping.\n")
    next
  }

  cyt_mat <- df_exp %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(cytokine_cols_all)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ log2(as.numeric(.) + PSEUDOCOUNT))) %>%
    as.matrix()
  rownames(cyt_mat) <- df_exp$SAMPLEID
  cyt_mat <- t(cyt_mat)

  rv <- apply(cyt_mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  cyt_mat <- cyt_mat[rv > 0 & !is.na(rv), ]
  cat("  Retained", nrow(cyt_mat), "cytokines\n")

  vp_form <- ~ (1 | SMOKER) + (1 | SEX) + (1 | HORMONE) + (1 | TIMEPOINT) +
    (1 | CELLTYPE) + (1 | EXPOSURE) + (1 | PATIENTCODE)

  vp_fit <- tryCatch(
    variancePartition::fitExtractVarPartModel(cyt_mat, vp_form, df_exp),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("  ⚠ Failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  if (is.null(vp_fit)) next

  vp_results_list[[exp]] <- vp_fit
  vp_summary_list[[exp]] <- as.data.frame(vp_fit) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Cytokine") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(. * 100, 2)),
      Exposure = exp
    )

  cat("  ✓ Done\n")
}

if (length(vp_results_list) > 0) {
  vp_summary_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(vp_summary_list)
  save_table(vp_summary_all, "smoker_variance_all_exposures.csv")

  vp_plots <- lapply(names(vp_results_list), function(exp) {
    variancePartition::plotVarPart(variancePartition::sortCols(vp_results_list[[exp]])) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = exp) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title  = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
        axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
      )
  })

  p_vp_combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = vp_plots, nrow = 2, ncol = 2, labels = "AUTO", label_size = 12)
  print(p_vp_combined)
  save_plot("smoker_variance_partition_all_exposures.png", p_vp_combined, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  p_smoker_dot <- vp_summary_all %>%
    dplyr::select(Cytokine, Exposure, SMOKER) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Exposure = factor(Exposure, levels = available_high_dose_exposures),
      Cytokine = reorder(Cytokine, SMOKER, FUN = mean)
    ) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = Exposure, y = Cytokine, size = SMOKER, color = SMOKER)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
    ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(name = "% Variance", range = c(1, 8), limits = c(0, NA)) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_gradient(low = "grey80", high = UP_COLOR, name = "% Variance") +
    ggplot2::labs(title = "SMOKER contribution to cytokine variance by fuel type", x = NULL, y = "Cytokine") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title       = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
      panel.border     = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(color = "gray88"),
      axis.text.x      = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y      = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position  = "right"
    )
  print(p_smoker_dot)
  save_plot("smoker_variance_summary_dotplot.png", p_smoker_dot, width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  pca_mat <- t(cyt_mat)
  cv <- apply(pca_mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  pca_mat <- pca_mat[, cv > 0 & !is.na(cv)]
  pca_res <- prcomp(pca_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  var_exp <- summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

  pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2]) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("SAMPLEID") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(df_exp %>% dplyr::select(SAMPLEID, SMOKER, SEX, HORMONE, TIMEPOINT, CELLTYPE, EXPOSURE, PATIENTCODE), by = "SAMPLEID")

  p_pca_smoker <- ggplot2::ggplot(pca_df, ggplot2::aes(PC1, PC2, fill = SMOKER, color = SMOKER, shape = SEX)) +
    ggplot2::stat_ellipse(ggplot2::aes(group = SMOKER), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.12, linewidth = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c("Y" = UP_COLOR, "N" = DOWN_COLOR), labels = c("Y" = "Smoker", "N" = "Non-smoker"), name = "Smoking status") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("Y" = UP_COLOR, "N" = DOWN_COLOR), labels = c("Y" = "Smoker", "N" = "Non-smoker"), name = "Smoking status") +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("M" = 21, "F" = 22), labels = c("M" = "Male", "F" = "Female"), name = "Sex") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)"), title = "PCA — Cytokine profiles by smoking status", subtitle = paste0("Last exposure: ", tail(names(vp_results_list), 1), " + PBS")) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13), plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, color = "grey40"), panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5), panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(color = "gray88"), panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank())

  p_pca_exposure <- ggplot2::ggplot(pca_df, ggplot2::aes(PC1, PC2, fill = EXPOSURE, color = EXPOSURE, shape = SMOKER)) +
    ggplot2::stat_ellipse(ggplot2::aes(group = EXPOSURE), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.12, linewidth = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(EXPOSURE_COLORS_DEEP, "PBS_Control" = "grey50"), name = "Exposure") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(EXPOSURE_COLORS_DEEP, "PBS_Control" = "grey50"), name = "Exposure") +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("Y" = 24, "N" = 21), labels = c("Y" = "Smoker", "N" = "Non-smoker"), name = "Smoking status") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)"), title = "PCA — Cytokine profiles by exposure", subtitle = "Shape = smoking status") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13), plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, color = "grey40"), panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5), panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(color = "gray88"), panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank())

  p_pca_combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(p_pca_smoker, p_pca_exposure, nrow = 1, labels = c("A", "B"), label_size = 14)
  print(p_pca_combined)
  save_plot("smoker_pca_combined.png", p_pca_combined, width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  cat("\n=== SMOKER DECISION GUIDE ===\n")
  cat("SMOKER >5% variance in ≥1 cytokine\n")
  cat("  → Add SMOKER as fixed effect in screen_one_exposure_lmer_log2()\n")
  cat("  → Formula: resp ~ EXPOSURE + SMOKER + (1|PATIENTCODE)\n\n")

  cat("Cytokines where SMOKER explains >5% variance:\n")
  vp_summary_all %>% dplyr::filter(SMOKER > 5) %>% dplyr::select(Exposure, Cytokine, SMOKER) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(SMOKER)) %>% print()
} else {
  cat("⚠ No variance partition results to plot.\n")
}
```
